**`agy-fast`** is a zero-dependency, policy-compliant local [MCP](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/) plugin for **Google Antigravity** (CLI `agy`, Desktop 2.0, and IDE). It cuts agent wall-clock latency, billable token quota, and upload traffic by consolidating high-frequency searches, multi-language symbol outlines, atomic multi-file edits, and build/test checks into batched local calls—and injecting a sub-50 ms workspace snapshot once per session—without altering Antigravity's native UI, diff viewer, modified-files list, checkpoints, or safety checks. | LLM Turns / 10 Actions | Est. Billable Quota | Tool-Return Upload | Spills & Native UI Impact | | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | | **-33.7%**

`-36.5%` ≥150k ctx · `-54.0%` subagents | **-39.7%**
`-53.7%` uncached fresh input | **0**
`≤8.8 KB` inline cap · Native diff & UI untouched |

## Quick Start **Requirements:** **Node.js >= 20** (no `npm install` needed — pre-built, unminified zero-dependency ESM bundles are included in `dist/`). Optional: [`ripgrep` (`rg`)](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep) for faster code search (automatically falls back to pure Node.js when absent). ### One-Command Install (Recommended) Installs runtime files to `~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-fast`, runs `agy plugin validate --strict` and `agy plugin enable agy-fast` when `agy` is installed, and verifies both the MCP server and `SessionStart` hook live: **macOS / Linux:** ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/INK-Q/agy-fast/main/install.sh | sh ``` **Windows (PowerShell):** ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/INK-Q/agy-fast/main/install.ps1 | iex ``` > [!TIP] > **Activating in Desktop 2.0 / IDE:** Open **Customizations → Installed** in Antigravity, confirm `agy-fast` is enabled, and start a **new session** to load the `SessionStart` hook and MCP tools. > > **Launching `agy` CLI without approval prompts (optional):** To auto-approve `agy-fast` MCP calls and tool permissions without prompting on every step, start the CLI with: > > ```bash > agy --dangerously-skip-permissions > ``` > > *(Official `agy` flag that auto-approves all tool permission requests without prompting — use only in trusted repositories, or pair with `--sandbox`.)*
More installation options (local clone, direct git clone, agy CLI, per-repo team install, or ask Antigravity) #### Local Clone (Any OS) ```bash git clone https://github.com/INK-Q/agy-fast.git cd agy-fast node scripts/install.mjs install ``` #### Direct Clone into Antigravity Plugins Directory (No Script Needed) Antigravity automatically discovers plugins placed in `~/.gemini/config/plugins/`: ```bash # macOS / Linux git clone https://github.com/INK-Q/agy-fast.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-fast ``` ```powershell # Windows (PowerShell) git clone https://github.com/INK-Q/agy-fast.git "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\agy-fast" ``` #### Native Antigravity CLI (`agy`) ```bash agy plugin install /path/to/agy-fast agy plugin enable agy-fast ``` #### Per-Repository Installation (Team Sharing) Install only for a single repository (writes to `/.agents/plugins/agy-fast`): ```bash node scripts/install.mjs install --project /path/to/your-repo ``` #### Ask Antigravity Directly Paste this prompt into Antigravity: ```text Clone https://github.com/INK-Q/agy-fast.git to ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-fast, run `node ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-fast/scripts/install.mjs doctor`, and enable the agy-fast plugin. ```
## How It Works Empirical analysis of **55 real Antigravity sessions** (**8,446 LLM turns**, **17,302 tool calls**, **55.25 hours** of single-agent active time; see [docs/ANALYSIS_REPORT.md](docs/ANALYSIS_REPORT.md)) revealed that slow tasks are rarely limited by token generation speed. Instead, four structural bottlenecks dominate wall-clock time: | Measured Bottleneck | Empirical Cost | How `agy-fast` Eliminates It | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Per-turn TTFT floor** | `~6.1 s` median TTFT (`79%` of a median turn; `68.1%` of turns emit `<700` tokens) | Batches an average of **4.89** logical actions per MCP call (`5.95×` in subagents), cutting unnecessary round-trip turns (`~6–8 s` each) | | **Serial checks & fragmented ops** | `52.5%` of `edit_file` calls are same-file splits; `46.3%` of `run_command` calls are read-only searches (`~2.0 s` median vs `2.1 ms` local `rg`) | Consolidates up to 20 searches, 50 file edits + `verify`, or 12 build/test commands inside one persistent local Stdio MCP server | | **Cold-start exploration** | First 3 turns average **49.2 seconds** inspecting directory layout, git state, and scripts | `SessionStart` hook injects a `≤1.5 KB` snapshot (git state, 2-level tree, multi-module scripts) once in `~35–50 ms` | | **Context bloat & cache decay** | `read_file` accounts for **81.9%** of tool-returned bytes; `>60 s` gaps spike cache misses from `1.4%` to `15.9%–93.8%` | Symbol outlines first + parallel targeted `read_file`, hard `≤8.8 KB` UTF-8 inline cap (zero `output.txt` disk spills), and multimodal isolation rules | ### Hybrid Execution Architecture `agy-fast` never replaces fast native reads. It combines batched local MCP tools with Antigravity's locally allowlisted `read_file` (`~7 ms`, `46 KB/call` inline, zero remote check):

### Plugin Components | Component | Path | Role | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Plugin Manifest** | [`plugin.json`](plugin.json) | Standard Antigravity manifest; passes `agy plugin validate --strict` | | **Local Stdio MCP Server** | [`mcp_config.json`](mcp_config.json) → [`dist/mcp-server.mjs`](dist/mcp-server.mjs) | Persistent local process exposing 5 eagerly loaded composite tools (`"eager": true`) under `agy-fast_fast` | | **Startup Snapshot Hook** | [`hooks.json`](hooks.json) → [`dist/session-start.mjs`](dist/session-start.mjs) | Runs once on `SessionStart` (`~35–50 ms`, `250 ms` scan circuit-breaker + OS/home-dir skip list), emitting a `≤1.5 KB` workspace snapshot | | **Routing & Hygiene Rules** | [`rules/AGENTS.md`](rules/AGENTS.md) | Compact (`~6.5 KB`) routing guide with inlined schemas (supports user-owned `rules/AGENTS.local.md` with `trigger: always_on` frontmatter, preserved across updates) | | **Background Auto-Updater** | [`dist/updater.mjs`](dist/updater.mjs) | Detached 4 h release checker with staged MCP smoke verification | | **Offline Benchmark CLI** | [`dist/benchmark.mjs`](dist/benchmark.mjs) | Local `transcript.jsonl` analyzer and before/after A/B comparator | ## Real-World Benchmarks Across **10 days of sanitized real coding transcripts** (**14 baseline main sessions / 5,771 turns** vs. **7 `agy-fast` main sessions / 901 turns**, plus **104 baseline vs. 4 `agy-fast` subagent sessions**; all repository names, paths, and identifiers stripped), each `agy-fast` call batched an average of **4.89 logical operations** (`5.95×` in subagents): | Metric *(normalized per logical action)* | Main Sessions (Baseline) | Main Sessions (`agy-fast`) | Delta | `≥150k` Long Context | Subagents | | :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | | **LLM turns / 10 actions** | 5.23 | **3.47** | **-33.7%** | **-38.2%** | **-58.8%** | | **Upstream requests / 10 actions** *(LLM + remote checks)* | 9.82 | **6.05** | **-38.4%** | **-42.6%** | **-62.0%** | | **Prompt Cache hit rate** *(miss spikes)* | 89.6% *(7.5%)* | **94.0%** *(4.8%)* | **+4.4 pp** | **95.0%** *(3.3%)* | 92.4% *(2.8%)* | | **Uncached fresh input / action** | 10,413 tok | **4,822 tok** | **-53.7%** | **-61.5%** | **-51.3%** | | **Est. billable quota / action** *(1 : 0.1 : 5)* | 22,458 eq | **15,387 eq** | **-31.5%** | **-36.5%** | **-54.0%** | | **Tool-return upload / action** *(actual local bytes)* | 5.06 KB | **3.05 KB** | **-39.7%** | **-42.6%** | **-13.3%** | | **Incremental text upload / action** *(fresh input est.)* | 35.6 KB | **16.5 KB** | **-53.7%** | **-61.6%** | **-51.3%** | | **Full-context text upload / action** *(stateless resend est.)* | 342.2 KB | **276.2 KB** | **-19.3%** | **-21.9%** | **-58.9%** | **Production hardening highlights (`v0.2.x`):** - **0 disk spills** across 134 consecutive `v0.2.x` MCP calls — strict `≤8.8 KB` UTF-8 inline cap prevents Antigravity's `output.txt` spill-to-disk extra turns. - **+75% effective throughput (`35.1 → 61.5 tok/s`)** and **`>60s` stall turns reduced from `31.2% → 7.4%`** in a same-session before/after `v0.2.1` comparison (99 vs. 374 turns) once multimodal screenshots were isolated out of `>180k`-token main sessions (`0` screenshots loaded in main coding sessions post-upgrade). - **0 lazy-load schema-read turns** — compact schemas are inlined directly in [`rules/AGENTS.md`](rules/AGENTS.md).
Methodology, quota sensitivity & fixed prompt overhead - **Logical action normalization:** One `batch_search` with 5 queries counts as 5 actions, one `apply_edits` touching 6 hunks + `verify` counts as 7 actions, and one built-in `read_file`/`edit_file`/`run_command` counts as 1 action—ensuring apples-to-apples comparison per unit of work rather than raw tool-call counts. - **Quota weighting sensitivity:** Standard weighting (`1.0×` uncached input, `0.1×` cache read, `5.0×` output) yields **-31.5%** on main sessions (**-36.5%** on `≥150k` sessions). Results hold under conservative cache discounts (`1 : 0.25 : 4` → **-25.8%**) and high-output weighting (`1 : 0.1 : 8` → **-29.4%**). - **Fixed prompt overhead:** `rules/AGENTS.md` + `SessionStart` snapshot add **~1.7k tokens** once per session (cached from turn 2 onward, `~170` eq tokens/turn). Avoiding a single redundant turn (`~44k` eq tokens) or blind full-file read pays back this overhead **>20×**.
### Verify on Your Own Transcripts (100% Offline) Measure your own Antigravity sessions locally — nothing ever leaves your machine: ```bash # Summarize all local Antigravity transcripts node dist/benchmark.mjs analyze --local # Analyze only the 10 most recently modified local transcripts node dist/benchmark.mjs analyze --local --recent 10 # Slice sessions since install time and compare With vs. Without agy-fast node dist/benchmark.mjs analyze --local --since 2026-11-19T12:51:00+08:00 --split-usage # Compare two task runs (before vs. after) node dist/benchmark.mjs compare --before ./run-before/transcript.jsonl --after ./run-after/transcript.jsonl ``` ## The 5 MCP Tools | Scenario | Preferred Tool | Why | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | Run ≥2 text, regex, glob, fuzzy, or read-only git queries | **`batch_search`** | 1 call for up to 20 concurrent queries (`<70 ms` local) | | Map unknown large files (`>300` lines) | **`quick_outline`** *(or **`read_slices`**)* | Flat `paths`-only symbol outlines across up to 40 files without full-file dumps | | Read small files (`<300` lines) or known line ranges | Built-in `read_file` | Locally allowlisted (`~7 ms`, `46 KB/call`, 0 remote check) | | Edit ≥2 hunks/files in one turn, or edit + verify | **`apply_edits`** | Atomic or `bestEffort` multi-file edits + optional inline `verify` | | Run ≥2 independent build, lint, test, or diagnostic commands | **`run_checks`** | Concurrent execution with head-tail folded error-focused output | ### 1. `batch_search` — Concurrent Code, Path & Read-Only Git Search - **Up to 20 mixed queries per call:** `text`, `regex`, `glob`, `fuzzy`, and read-only `git` (`status`, `diff`, `log`, `show`, `branch`, `rev-parse`, `ls-files`, `blame`, `shortlog`, `describe`, `tag --list`, `remote -v`), including cross-repo lookups via per-query `path`. - **Precision controls:** Filter by `fileType` (e.g., `typescript`, `python`, `gdscript`) or `glob`, switch `outputMode` (`content` | `files_with_matches` | `count`), enable cross-line `multiline: true` (where `count` reports occurrences per file), use `type: "fuzzy"` for case-insensitive path matching, or pass `sortBy: "mtime"` on `glob` queries for newest-first results. - **Resilient & inline-safe:** Uses `rg` when installed with automatic Node.js fallback, auto-recovers common LLM `glob` mistakes (`|` alternation and bare keywords), and enforces the `≤8.8 KB` UTF-8 cap. ### 2. `apply_edits` — Atomic Multi-Hunk & Multi-File Edits + Verify - **Up to 50 files per call:** Validates every hunk and overlap in memory before touching disk (`0` files modified on error), or pass `bestEffort: true` on larger batches so valid files commit atomically per file while failed files return closest-line / drifted-line snippets for targeted retry. - **Faithful file handling:** Preserves CRLF line endings, file permissions, and symlinks; supports `startLine`/`endLine`, `replaceAll`, `create`/`overwrite`, and `dryRun`. - **Inline `verify`:** Optionally runs a build/typecheck/test command right after writing, stripping noisy logs (e.g., Pino/Bunyan info JSON, Maven footers) so root causes stay within budget. ### 3. `quick_outline` — Flat Multi-Language Symbol Outlines - **Up to 40 files per call** *(10–20 recommended per batch)*: Takes a flat `paths: string[]` array to extract exact `[startLine, endLine]` symbol/section maps for **TypeScript / JavaScript** *(incl. Fastify/Express routes & test blocks)*, **HTML / Vue / Svelte**, **CSS / SCSS / Less**, **Python**, **Godot GDScript (`.gd`)**, **Go**, **Rust**, **Java / Kotlin / C# / Swift / C / C++**, **Shell**, **Markdown**, and **JSON / YAML**—making outline-first exploration effortless before parallel built-in `read_file`. ### 4. `read_slices` — Symbol Outlines + Targeted Line Slices - **Outlines + piggybacked slices:** Supports the same 15-format outlines (with breadth-first water-filling per file) plus optional tiny `[startLine, endLine]` slices in one call under the `≤8.8 KB` UTF-8 budget, while steering bulk range reads (`>150` lines) to parallel built-in `read_file`. ### 5. `run_checks` — Concurrent Build, Lint, Test & Diagnostic Runner - **Up to 12 commands per call:** Executes independent non-interactive shell commands in a bounded worker pool (`concurrency: 1..8`) with per-command timeouts (`1..170 s`, sharing a `170 s` call budget under Antigravity's `180 s` MCP limit), ANSI escape stripping, and transparent Windows unwrapping of trivial `powershell -Command "..."` wrappers around allowlisted binaries (`git`, `npm`, `node`, `rg`, `pytest`, `cargo`, etc.) to skip PowerShell cold-start overhead while leaving PowerShell cmdlets/aliases untouched. - **Head-Tail adaptive output modes:** `compact` (default) collapses passing commands to 1-line summaries and uses **Head-Tail folding** on large failures so both initial root-cause errors and final summary/stack tails survive the `≤8.8 KB` inline cap; `full` preserves stdout for diagnostic or audit scripts with Head-Tail folding when capped.
Example batched MCP calls (JSON payloads) **`batch_search` — 3 heterogeneous queries in one call:** ```json { "queries": [ { "type": "regex", "pattern": "export (async )?function", "fileType": "typescript", "outputMode": "files_with_matches" }, { "type": "fuzzy", "pattern": "mcp server" }, { "type": "git", "pattern": "status --short" } ] } ``` **`apply_edits` — Multi-file edit + inline typecheck in one call:** ```json { "edits": [ { "path": "src/a.ts", "hunks": [{ "target": "oldCall()", "replacement": "newCall()" }] }, { "path": "src/b.ts", "hunks": [{ "target": "v1", "replacement": "v2", "startLine": 10, "endLine": 25 }] } ], "bestEffort": true, "verify": "npm run typecheck" } ```
## Updates, Diagnostics, and Uninstall ### Day-to-Day CLI Reference | Task | Command | | :--- | :--- | | **Health check** *(Node, `rg`, live MCP handshake, `SessionStart` latency, manifest validation)* | `node ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-fast/scripts/install.mjs doctor` | | **Check for updates** *(read-only)* | `node ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-fast/scripts/install.mjs update --check` | | **Update now** *(stages & runs MCP smoke test before swapping)* | `node ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-fast/scripts/install.mjs update` | | **Configure auto-update** *(`auto` \| `notify` \| `off`)* | `node ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-fast/scripts/install.mjs config --auto-update notify --interval 24` | | **Switch MCP tool loading** *(`eager` \| `lazy`, preserved across updates)* | `node ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-fast/scripts/install.mjs config --tool-loading lazy` | | **Direct CLI mode** *(for Swarm workers & non-MCP scripts)* | `node ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-fast/dist/mcp-server.mjs --cli ` | | **Uninstall cleanly** | `node ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-fast/scripts/install.mjs uninstall` | > From a local repository clone, `./install.sh ` (macOS/Linux) and `.\install.ps1 ` (Windows) accept the same subcommands (`doctor`, `update`, `config`, `uninstall`). ### Zero-Latency Background Auto-Updater - **0 ms session startup cost:** Every **4 hours**, `SessionStart` spawns a detached background process (`dist/updater.mjs`) *after* emitting the workspace snapshot. - **Verified before swap:** Checks GitHub release tags (`git ls-remote --tags` with GitHub Releases API fallback), clones into an isolated staging directory, runs a **live MCP smoke test**, and atomically replaces runtime files—automatically rejecting broken releases while preserving any user-created `rules/AGENTS.local.md` (add `---\ntrigger: always_on\n---` YAML frontmatter so Antigravity loads it; gitignored for `git clone` installs). - **Safe by design:** Standard copied installs and clean direct `git clone` installs auto-update automatically; `--link` dev symlinks and dirty git repos are **never overwritten** (notify-only). A one-time notice appears in the next new session when an update is applied or available.
Environment variable overrides & applying updates | Environment Variable | Values / Default | Purpose | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `AGY_FAST_AUTO_UPDATE` | `auto` *(default)* \| `notify` \| `off` | Overrides saved auto-update mode | | `AGY_FAST_UPDATE_INTERVAL_HOURS` | `12` *(default; `1..720`)* | Background check interval in hours | | `AGY_FAST_UPDATE_CHANNEL` | `release` *(default)* \| `main` | Track stable semver release tags or `main` | | `AGY_FAST_REPO` | Git URL | Use a custom mirror or fork | | `AGY_FAST_EDITS_FORMAT` | `auto` *(default)* \| `array` \| `string` | Controls `apply_edits.edits` schema (`auto` uses token-saving native arrays on eager-capable CLI ≥1.5.8, Desktop 2.0, IDE, and third-party hosts, and switches to JSON array strings on pre-eager CLI 1.5.0–1.5.7; server always accepts both) | | `AGY_FAST_HOST` | e.g. `cli@1.5.14`, `ide@2.7.0`, `desktop@2.34.0` | Overrides auto-detected Antigravity host surface & version | **Applying updates:** Updated `rules/AGENTS.md` and `dist/session-start.mjs` take effect automatically on the next new session. In Antigravity Desktop 2.0 / IDE, reload or restart the window once to refresh the resident MCP server process.
## Policy Compliance and Safety - **Official interfaces only:** Built exclusively on documented Antigravity extension APIs (`plugin.json`, `mcp_config.json`, `hooks.json`, `rules/AGENTS.md`). - **Non-invasive by design:** Never alters or interferes with Antigravity's native UI, **diff viewer/window**, **modified-files list**, checkpoints, or built-in tools. - **No safety or binary tampering:** Does not patch client binaries, alter authentication, or bypass Antigravity's built-in safety evaluations. - **Zero per-step blocking hooks:** Registers no `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`, `PreInvocation`, `PostInvocation`, or `Stop` hooks. - **Fail-open startup hook:** On unreadable directories or malformed stdin, `SessionStart` returns `{}` and exits cleanly—never blocking a session. - **Local-first & auditable:** All 5 MCP tools and the benchmark CLI run 100% locally with zero code or transcript uploads; shipped `dist/*.mjs` bundles are unminified ESM so every executed line is directly auditable. ## FAQ ### Does `agy-fast` affect Antigravity's native UI, diff viewer, or modified-files list? No. `agy-fast` runs strictly as a standard local Stdio MCP plugin with a `SessionStart` hook. It never patches the Antigravity client or interferes with the native diff viewer/window, modified-files list, checkpoints, built-in tools, or safety checks. ### Does `agy-fast` save token quota and upload bandwidth in addition to reducing latency? Yes. Across 10 days of sanitized real coding transcripts, batching ~4.9 operations per MCP call reduced LLM turns by **33.7%**, estimated billable token quota by **31.5%** (**36.5%** in `≥150k`-token sessions; **54.0%** in subagents), tool-return upload bytes by **39.7%**, and `>60s` stall turns from **31.2% → 7.4%**. ### Does `agy-fast` replace Antigravity's built-in `read_file` or `edit_file` tools? No — it complements them in a hybrid workflow. Built-in `read_file` is locally allowlisted (`~7 ms`, `46 KB/call`, zero remote check), so `agy-fast` routes small files and known line ranges straight to parallel built-in `read_file`, while handling multi-query searches, symbol outlines, multi-hunk/multi-file edits with inline `verify`, and concurrent checks via MCP. ### Which Antigravity editions and operating systems are supported? `agy-fast` supports **Antigravity CLI (`agy`)**, **Antigravity Desktop 2.0**, and **Antigravity IDE** across **macOS, Linux, and Windows**. It requires **Node.js >= 20** with zero runtime dependencies (optional `ripgrep`/`rg` with automatic pure-Node.js fallback). ### Does `agy-fast` send any code or transcript data to external servers? No. All MCP tools, the `SessionStart` snapshot hook, and the transcript benchmark CLI operate 100% locally. The only optional network request is the background update checker checking public GitHub release tags once every 4 hours, which can be switched to `notify` or disabled completely via `config --auto-update off` or `AGY_FAST_AUTO_UPDATE=off`. ### How do I verify the speedup or uninstall `agy-fast` cleanly? Run `node dist/benchmark.mjs analyze --local --split-usage` to benchmark your own local transcripts completely offline. To remove `agy-fast` at any time, run `node ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-fast/scripts/install.mjs uninstall`. ## Development ```bash npm install npm run typecheck # Strict TypeScript check npm run build # Bundle src/*.ts -> dist/*.mjs with esbuild npm test # Run unit, MCP protocol, hook, benchmark, and installer tests npm run bench:stress # Run 12-scenario end-to-end stress & performance benchmark npm run validate # Run `agy plugin validate --strict .` ``` ## MCP Directory ## Star History ## License [MIT](LICENSE)

## 快速开始 **环境要求：Node.js >= 20**（无需执行 `npm install`，仓库已附带未混淆的零依赖单文件 ESM 产物 `dist/*.mjs`）。可选安装 [`ripgrep` (`rg`)](https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep) 进一步加速代码搜索（未安装时自动回退至纯 Node.js 并发遍历）。 ### 一行命令安装（推荐） 自动安装运行文件到 `~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-fast`，若本机存在 `agy` CLI 则自动执行严格校验与启用，并完成 MCP 与 `SessionStart` 实时自检： **macOS / Linux：** ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/INK-Q/agy-fast/main/install.sh | sh ``` **Windows（PowerShell）：** ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/INK-Q/agy-fast/main/install.ps1 | iex ``` > [!TIP] > **Desktop 2.0 / IDE 启用提示：** 打开 Antigravity 侧边栏的 **Customizations → Installed**，确认 `agy-fast` 已处于开启状态，然后开启一个**新会话**即可激活启动快照钩子与 MCP 工具。 > > **以无需审批模式启动 `agy` CLI（可选）：** 如果希望在 CLI 中连续调用 `agy-fast` 等工具而不必每次手动确认审批，可使用官方参数启动： > > ```bash > agy --dangerously-skip-permissions > ``` > > *（该参数会自动批准所有工具权限请求且不再弹窗询问，建议仅在受信任的代码仓库中使用，或配合 `--sandbox` 一起启用。）*

## 工作原理 基于 **55 个真实 Antigravity 会话**（**8,446 轮模型调用**、**17,302 次工具调用**、**55.25 小时**纯单 Agent 活跃时间，详见脱敏报告 [docs/ANALYSIS_REPORT.zh-CN.md](docs/ANALYSIS_REPORT.zh-CN.md)）的定量分析，任务慢的根因通常并非模型解码速度，而是 4 项结构性开销： | 实测性能瓶颈 | 定量开销 | `agy-fast` 的解决方案 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **每轮固定首字等待（TTFT）** | 中位数 `~6.1 秒`（占中位数轮次约 `79%`；`68.1%` 轮次输出 `<700` tokens） | 单次 MCP 调用平均打包 **4.89** 个逻辑操作（子代理达 **5.95×**），大幅削减无效往返轮次（每轮 `~6–8 秒`） | | **工具串行校验与细粒度拆分** | `52.5%` 的 `edit_file` 是同轮同文件拆分；`46.3%` 的 `run_command` 是只读搜索（中位数 `~2.0 秒` vs 本地 `rg` `2.1 ms`） | 在本地常驻 Stdio MCP 中一次合并最多 20 条搜索、50 个文件编辑 + `verify` 或 12 条并发检查命令 | | **会话冷启动探索耗时** | 前 3 轮平均花费 **49.2 秒**检查目录结构、git 状态与脚本 | `SessionStart` 钩子仅在启动时运行一次（`~35–50 ms`），注入 `≤1.5 KB` 精简工作区快照 | | **上下文膨胀与缓存失效** | `read_file` 占工具返回体积的 **81.9%**；`>60 秒` 间隔使缓存失效率从 `1.4%` 飙升至 `15.9%–93.8%` | 先提取符号大纲再并行精确读取、全工具死守 `≤8.8 KB` UTF-8 内联上限（杜绝 `output.txt` 溢盘）并隔离多模态截图 | ### 混合执行架构 `agy-fast` 不会取代原本就极快的内置读取，而是将“批量合并型操作”交给本地 MCP，同时把小文件与已知行段直接路由给本地白名单内置 `read_file`（`~7 ms`、单次 `46 KB` 内联、零远端校验）：

### 插件组成 | 模块 | 文件路径 | 作用 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **原生插件清单** | [`plugin.json`](plugin.json) | 符合官方规范的元数据，通过 `agy plugin validate --strict` 零警告校验 | | **本地常驻 MCP 服务** | [`mcp_config.json`](mcp_config.json) → [`dist/mcp-server.mjs`](dist/mcp-server.mjs) | 常驻本地进程，在 `agy-fast_fast` 下以急加载（`"eager": true`）暴露 5 个强类型合并工具 | | **会话启动快照钩子** | [`hooks.json`](hooks.json) → [`dist/session-start.mjs`](dist/session-start.mjs) | 仅在 `SessionStart` 运行一次（`~35–50 ms`，内置 `250 ms` 扫描熔断与系统/用户目录黑名单），注入 `≤1.5 KB` 项目/Git/目录快照 | | **工具路由与卫生规则** | [`rules/AGENTS.md`](rules/AGENTS.md) | 约 `6.5 KB` 精简路由规则，内联参数签名（支持自定义 `rules/AGENTS.local.md`，需带 `trigger: always_on` frontmatter，更新与重装自动保留） | | **后台自动更新器** | [`dist/updater.mjs`](dist/updater.mjs) | 4 小时分离式后台检查，先暂存执行 MCP 冒烟校验再原子替换 | | **离线基准测试工具** | [`dist/benchmark.mjs`](dist/benchmark.mjs) | 本地解析 `transcript.jsonl` 并输出单次指标或前后 A/B 对比 | ## 实测数据 基于连续 **10 天脱敏真实编码轨迹** 统计（**14 场基线主会话 / 5,771 轮** vs. **7 场启用 `agy-fast` 主会话 / 901 轮**，以及 **104 场基线 vs. 4 场插件子代理会话**；已剥离全部仓库名、路径与会话标识），`agy-fast` 单次调用平均打包 **4.89 个逻辑操作**（子代理达 **5.95×**）： | 核心指标 *（按“单位有效操作”归一化）* | 主会话 · 基线 | 主会话 · `agy-fast` | 变化 | `≥150k` 长上下文主会话 | 子代理 | | :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | | **每 10 操作所需模型轮次** | 5.23 轮 | **3.47 轮** | **-33.7%** | **-38.2%** | **-58.8%** | | **每 10 操作上行请求数** *（LLM + 远端校验）* | 9.82 次 | **6.05 次** | **-38.4%** | **-42.6%** | **-62.0%** | | **Prompt Cache 命中率** *（失效尖峰占比）* | 89.6% *(7.5%)* | **94.0%** *(4.8%)* | **+4.4 pp** | **95.0%** *(3.3%)* | 92.4% *(2.8%)* | | **每操作全价新增输入（未命中缓存）** | 10,413 tok | **4,822 tok** | **-53.7%** | **-61.5%** | **-51.3%** | | **每操作综合折算额度** *（权重 1 : 0.1 : 5）* | 22,458 eq | **15,387 eq** | **-31.5%** | **-36.5%** | **-54.0%** | | **每操作工具返回上传字节** *（本地实测）* | 5.06 KB | **3.05 KB** | **-39.7%** | **-42.6%** | **-13.3%** | | **每操作增量新增文本上传** *（增量同步口径）* | 35.6 KB | **16.5 KB** | **-53.7%** | **-61.6%** | **-51.3%** | | **每操作全量历史文本上传** *（无状态重传估算）* | 342.2 KB | **276.2 KB** | **-19.3%** | **-21.9%** | **-58.9%** | **`v0.2.x` 生产实测亮点：** - **连续 134 次 MCP 调用 `0` 次溢盘**：全工具死守 `≤8.8 KB` UTF-8 内联硬上限，彻底消除输出落盘 `output.txt` 带来的二次读取损耗。 - **有效吞吐 `+75%`（`35.1 → 61.5 tok/s`），`>60s` 严重卡顿从 `31.2%` 降至 `7.4%`**：在同一场跨版本长会话前后对照（99 轮 vs. 374 轮）中，启用多模态隔离规则后主编码会话加载截图数降至 `0`，避开 `>180k` 上下文多模态 TTFT 悬崖。 - 统计口径、多权重敏感性校验与固定 Prompt 开销说明 - **逻辑操作归一化**：1 次含 5 个查询的 `batch_search` 计 5 个操作，1 次含 6 处 hunk + `verify` 的 `apply_edits` 计 7 个操作，内置 `read_file`/`edit_file`/`run_command` 计 1 个操作，确保按“同等实际工作量”公平对比。 - **多权重敏感性校验**：标准权重（未缓存输入 `1.0` : 缓存读 `0.1` : 输出 `5.0`）下主会话省 **31.5%**（`≥150k` 长上下文省 **36.5%**）；换用保守缓存折扣（`1 : 0.25 : 4` → **-25.8%**）或高输出权重（`1 : 0.1 : 8` → **-29.4%**）结论一致。 - **固定 Prompt 开销**：`rules/AGENTS.md` + `SessionStart` 快照每会话合计仅增加 **~1.7k tokens**（第 2 轮起命中缓存，每轮约 `170` eq tokens）；只要省掉 **1 次多余轮次**（`~44k` eq tokens）或 1 次大文件盲读即可回本 **20 倍以上**。
### 本地离线验证你自己的日志（零数据上传） ```bash # 统计本机全部 Antigravity 历史轨迹的基线指标 node dist/benchmark.mjs analyze --local # 仅分析最近修改的 10 个本地会话 node dist/benchmark.mjs analyze --local --recent 10 # 按插件安装时间切分（兼容旧对话续聊），对比“已用 vs 未用 agy-fast” node dist/benchmark.mjs analyze --local --since 2026-11-19T12:51:00+08:00 --split-usage # 对比同一任务启用插件前后的指标变化 node dist/benchmark.mjs compare --before ./before/transcript.jsonl --after ./after/transcript.jsonl ``` ## 5 个核心 MCP 工具 | 任务场景 | 推荐工具 | 核心原因 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | 执行 ≥2 条文本、正则、Glob、模糊路径或只读 Git 查询 | **`batch_search`** | 1 次调用并发跑最多 20 条查询（本地 `<70 ms`） | | 摸清未知大文件结构（`>300` 行） | **`quick_outline`** *（或 **`read_slices`**）* | 扁平 `paths` 参数一次提取最多 40 个文件符号大纲，避免盲读整文件 | | 读取小文件（`<300` 行）或已知行号区间 | 内置 `read_file` | 本地白名单直放（`~7 ms`、单次 `46 KB`、零远端校验） | | 同轮多处/跨文件编辑，或“编辑 + 校验” | **`apply_edits`** | 原子或 `bestEffort` 落盘 + 可选内联 `verify` | | 执行 ≥2 条独立构建、检查、测试或诊断命令 | **`run_checks`** | 受控并发执行，头尾折叠提取核心报错与测试汇总 | ### 1. `batch_search` — 并发代码检索、模糊路径与只读 Git 查询 - **单次最多 20 条混合查询**：支持 `text`、`regex`、`glob`、`fuzzy` 与只读 `git`（`status`、`diff`、`log`、`show`、`branch`、`rev-parse`、`ls-files`、`blame`、`shortlog`、`describe`、`tag --list`、`remote -v`），并支持按条传入 `path` 跨目录/跨仓库查询。 - **精细控制**：支持 `fileType`（如 `typescript`、`python`、`gdscript`）与 `glob` 过滤、`outputMode`（`content` | `files_with_matches` | `count`）、跨行匹配 `multiline: true`（此时 `count` 统计逐文件匹配次数）、`type: "fuzzy"` 忽略大小写模糊路径查找以及 `glob` 的 `sortBy: "mtime"` 最新修改优先排序。 - **高容错与内联防溢盘**：优先调用 `rg`（缺失自动回退 Node.js），对常见 `glob` 误传（正则 `|` 与裸关键词）自动容错恢复，默认死守 `≤8.8 KB` UTF-8 内联上限。 ### 2. `apply_edits` — 原子多处/跨文件编辑 + 内联校验 - **单次最多 50 个文件**：默认全内存预校验后原子写入（任意失配或重叠均不改动磁盘）；大批量可传 `bestEffort: true` 按文件原子提交成功项，并对失败项自动返回最相近代码行与行号漂移提示，便于精准重试。 - **无损保留文件属性**：保留 CRLF 换行符、文件权限与软链接；支持 `startLine`/`endLine`、`replaceAll`、`create`/`overwrite` 与 `dryRun`。 - **可选内联 `verify`**：落盘后直接执行构建/类型检查/测试命令，自动过滤 Pino/Bunyan info JSON 与 Maven 尾注噪声，保留核心报错根因。 ### 3. `quick_outline` — 极简多语言符号大纲提取 - **扁平参数，单次最多 40 个文件** *（推荐 10–20 个/批）*：仅需传入扁平 `paths: string[]` 即可提取起止行号，覆盖 **TypeScript / JavaScript** *（含 Fastify/Express 路由与测试块）*、**HTML / Vue / Svelte**、**CSS / SCSS / Less**、**Python**、**Godot GDScript（`.gd`）**、**Go**、**Rust**、**Java / Kotlin / C# / Swift / C / C++**、**Shell**、**Markdown** 与 **JSON / YAML**，配合并行内置 `read_file` 极简顺手。 ### 4. `read_slices` — 符号大纲 + 精确行段切片 - **大纲与小切片合一**：支持同等 15 种格式符号大纲（支持单文件广度优先水填充分配），并可在同一次请求中顺带读取少量小行段（总输出死守 `≤8.8 KB` UTF-8 上限）；大段正文读取自动引导至并行内置 `read_file`。 ### 5. `run_checks` — 并发构建、规范检查、测试与诊断执行器 - **单次最多 12 条命令**：在受控并发池（`concurrency: 1..8`）中并行执行独立非交互命令，支持单条超时强杀（`1..170 s`，单次调用共享 `170 s` 预算以适配 Antigravity `180 s` MCP 上限）、ANSI 转义符清理，并在 Windows 下自动透明解包针对白名单 CLI（`git`/`npm`/`node`/`rg`/`pytest`/`cargo` 等）的冗余 `powershell -Command "..."` 包装，免去 PowerShell 冷启动开销（PowerShell cmdlet、别名与管道完全原样保留）。 - **头尾折叠（Head-Tail）双输出模式**：默认 `compact` 模式将通过项折叠为 1 行摘要、超长失败日志采用**头尾折叠**（同时保留首条根因报错与末尾测试汇总/堆栈尾部）；`full` 模式在 `≤8.8 KB` 预算内保留标准输出，超限时同样采用头尾折叠。
批量 MCP 调用示例（JSON 参数） **`batch_search` — 单次并发执行 3 类异构查询：** ```json { "queries": [ { "type": "regex", "pattern": "export (async )?function", "fileType": "typescript", "outputMode": "files_with_matches" }, { "type": "fuzzy", "pattern": "mcp server" }, { "type": "git", "pattern": "status --short" } ] } ``` **`apply_edits` — 跨文件编辑 + 内联类型检查一步完成：** ```json { "edits": [ { "path": "src/a.ts", "hunks": [{ "target": "oldCall()", "replacement": "newCall()" }] }, { "path": "src/b.ts", "hunks": [{ "target": "v1", "replacement": "v2", "startLine": 10, "endLine": 25 }] } ], "bestEffort": true, "verify": "npm run typecheck" } ```

## Quick Start **Requirements:** **Node.js >= 20** (no `npm install` needed — pre-built, unminified zero-dependency ESM bundles are included in `dist/`). More installation options (local clone, direct git clone, agy CLI, per-repo team install, or ask Antigravity) #### Local Clone (Any OS) ```bash git clone https://github.com/INK-Q/agy-fast.git cd agy-fast node scripts/install.mjs install ``` #### Direct Clone into Antigravity Plugins Directory (No Script Needed) Antigravity automatically discovers plugins placed in `~/.gemini/config/plugins/`: ```bash # macOS / Linux git clone https://github.com/INK-Q/agy-fast.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-fast ``` ```powershell # Windows (PowerShell) git clone https://github.com/INK-Q/agy-fast.git "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\agy-fast" ``` #### Native Antigravity CLI (`agy`) ```bash agy plugin install /path/to/agy-fast agy plugin enable agy-fast ``` #### Per-Repository Installation (Team Sharing) Install only for a single repository (writes to `/.agents/plugins/agy-fast`): ```bash node scripts/install.mjs install --project /path/to/your-repo ``` #### Ask Antigravity Directly Paste this prompt into Antigravity: ```text Clone https://github.com/INK-Q/agy-fast.git to ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-fast, run `node ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-fast/scripts/install.mjs doctor`, and enable the agy-fast plugin. ```
## How It Works Empirical analysis of **55 real Antigravity sessions** (**8,446 LLM turns**, **17,302 tool calls**, **55.25 hours** of single-agent active time; see [docs/ANALYSIS_REPORT.md](docs/ANALYSIS_REPORT.md)) revealed that slow tasks are rarely limited by token generation speed. Instead, four structural bottlenecks dominate wall-clock time: | Measured Bottleneck | Empirical Cost | How `agy-fast` Eliminates It | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Per-turn TTFT floor** | `~6.1 s` median TTFT (`79%` of a median turn; `68.1%` of turns emit `<700` tokens) | Batches an average of **4.89** logical actions per MCP call (`5.95×` in subagents), cutting unnecessary round-trip turns (`~6–8 s` each) | | **Serial checks & fragmented ops** | `52.5%` of `edit_file` calls are same-file splits; `46.3%` of `run_command` calls are read-only searches (`~2.0 s` median vs `2.1 ms` local `rg`) | Consolidates up to 20 searches, 50 file edits + `verify`, or 12 build/test commands inside one persistent local Stdio MCP server | | **Cold-start exploration** | First 3 turns average **49.2 seconds** inspecting directory layout, git state, and scripts | `SessionStart` hook injects a `≤1.5 KB` snapshot (git state, 2-level tree, multi-module scripts) once in `~35–50 ms` | | **Context bloat & cache decay** | `read_file` accounts for **81.9%** of tool-returned bytes; `>60 s` gaps spike cache misses from `1.4%` to `15.9%–93.8%` | Symbol outlines first + parallel targeted `read_file`, hard `≤8.8 KB` UTF-8 inline cap (zero `output.txt` disk spills), and multimodal isolation rules | ### Hybrid Execution Architecture `agy-fast` never replaces fast native reads. It combines batched local MCP tools with Antigravity's locally allowlisted `read_file` (`~7 ms`, `46 KB/call` inline, zero remote check):

### Plugin Components | Component | Path | Role | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Plugin Manifest** | [`plugin.json`](plugin.json) | Standard Antigravity manifest; passes `agy plugin validate --strict` | | **Local Stdio MCP Server** | [`mcp_config.json`](mcp_config.json) → [`dist/mcp-server.mjs`](dist/mcp-server.mjs) | Persistent local process exposing 5 eagerly loaded composite tools (`"eager": true`) under `agy-fast_fast` | | **Startup Snapshot Hook** | [`hooks.json`](hooks.json) → [`dist/session-start.mjs`](dist/session-start.mjs) | Runs once on `SessionStart` (`~35–50 ms`, `250 ms` scan circuit-breaker + OS/home-dir skip list), emitting a `≤1.5 KB` workspace snapshot | | **Routing & Hygiene Rules** | [`rules/AGENTS.md`](rules/AGENTS.md) | Compact (`~6.5 KB`) routing guide with inlined schemas (supports user-owned `rules/AGENTS.local.md` with `trigger: always_on` frontmatter, preserved across updates) | | **Background Auto-Updater** | [`dist/updater.mjs`](dist/updater.mjs) | Detached 4 h release checker with staged MCP smoke verification | | **Offline Benchmark CLI** | [`dist/benchmark.mjs`](dist/benchmark.mjs) | Local `transcript.jsonl` analyzer and before/after A/B comparator | ## Real-World Benchmarks Across **10 days of sanitized real coding transcripts** (**14 baseline main sessions / 5,771 turns** vs. **7 `agy-fast` main sessions / 901 turns**, plus **104 baseline vs. 4 `agy-fast` subagent sessions**; all repository names, paths, and identifiers stripped), each `agy-fast` call batched an average of **4.89 logical operations** (`5.95×` in subagents): | Metric *(normalized per logical action)* | Main Sessions (Baseline) | Main Sessions (`agy-fast`) | Delta | `≥150k` Long Context | Subagents | | :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | | **LLM turns / 10 actions** | 5.23 | **3.47** | **-33.7%** | **-38.2%** | **-58.8%** | | **Upstream requests / 10 actions** *(LLM + remote checks)* | 9.82 | **6.05** | **-38.4%** | **-42.6%** | **-62.0%** | | **Prompt Cache hit rate** *(miss spikes)* | 89.6% *(7.5%)* | **94.0%** *(4.8%)* | **+4.4 pp** | **95.0%** *(3.3%)* | 92.4% *(2.8%)* | | **Uncached fresh input / action** | 10,413 tok | **4,822 tok** | **-53.7%** | **-61.5%** | **-51.3%** | | **Est. billable quota / action** *(1 : 0.1 : 5)* | 22,458 eq | **15,387 eq** | **-31.5%** | **-36.5%** | **-54.0%** | | **Tool-return upload / action** *(actual local bytes)* | 5.06 KB | **3.05 KB** | **-39.7%** | **-42.6%** | **-13.3%** | | **Incremental text upload / action** *(fresh input est.)* | 35.6 KB | **16.5 KB** | **-53.7%** | **-61.6%** | **-51.3%** | | **Full-context text upload / action** *(stateless resend est.)* | 342.2 KB | **276.2 KB** | **-19.3%** | **-21.9%** | **-58.9%** | **Production hardening highlights (`v0.2.x`):** - **0 disk spills** across 134 consecutive `v0.2.x` MCP calls — strict `≤8.8 KB` UTF-8 inline cap prevents Antigravity's `output.txt` spill-to-disk extra turns. - **+75% effective throughput (`35.1 → 61.5 tok/s`)** and **`>60s` stall turns reduced from `31.2% → 7.4%`** in a same-session before/after `v0.2.1` comparison (99 vs. 374 turns) once multimodal screenshots were isolated out of `>180k`-token main sessions (`0` screenshots loaded in main coding sessions post-upgrade). - **0 lazy-load schema-read turns** — compact schemas are inlined directly in [`rules/AGENTS.md`](rules/AGENTS.md).
Methodology, quota sensitivity & fixed prompt overhead - **Logical action normalization:** One `batch_search` with 5 queries counts as 5 actions, one `apply_edits` touching 6 hunks + `verify` counts as 7 actions, and one built-in `read_file`/`edit_file`/`run_command` counts as 1 action—ensuring apples-to-apples comparison per unit of work rather than raw tool-call counts. - **Quota weighting sensitivity:** Standard weighting (`1.0×` uncached input, `0.1×` cache read, `5.0×` output) yields **-31.5%** on main sessions (**-36.5%** on `≥150k` sessions). Avoiding a single redundant turn (`~44k` eq tokens) or blind full-file read pays back this overhead **>20×**.
### Verify on Your Own Transcripts (100% Offline) Measure your own Antigravity sessions locally — nothing ever leaves your machine: ```bash # Summarize all local Antigravity transcripts node dist/benchmark.mjs analyze --local # Analyze only the 10 most recently modified local transcripts node dist/benchmark.mjs analyze --local --recent 10 # Slice sessions since install time and compare With vs. Without agy-fast node dist/benchmark.mjs analyze --local --since 2026-11-19T12:51:00+08:00 --split-usage # Compare two task runs (before vs. after) node dist/benchmark.mjs compare --before ./run-before/transcript.jsonl --after ./run-after/transcript.jsonl ``` ## The 5 MCP Tools | Scenario | Preferred Tool | Why | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | Run ≥2 text, regex, glob, fuzzy, or read-only git queries | **`batch_search`** | 1 call for up to 20 concurrent queries (`<70 ms` local) | | Map unknown large files (`>300` lines) | **`quick_outline`** *(or **`read_slices`**)* | Flat `paths`-only symbol outlines across up to 40 files without full-file dumps | | Read small files (`<300` lines) or known line ranges | Built-in `read_file` | Locally allowlisted (`~7 ms`, `46 KB/call`, 0 remote check) | | Edit ≥2 hunks/files in one turn, or edit + verify | **`apply_edits`** | Atomic or `bestEffort` multi-file edits + optional inline `verify` | | Run ≥2 independent build, lint, test, or diagnostic commands | **`run_checks`** | Concurrent execution with head-tail folded error-focused output | ### 1. `batch_search` — Concurrent Code, Path & Read-Only Git Search - **Up to 20 mixed queries per call:** `text`, `regex`, `glob`, `fuzzy`, and read-only `git` (`status`, `diff`, `log`, `show`, `branch`, `rev-parse`, `ls-files`, `blame`, `shortlog`, `describe`, `tag --list`, `remote -v`), including cross-repo lookups via per-query `path`. - **Precision controls:** Filter by `fileType` (e.g., `typescript`, `python`, `gdscript`) or `glob`, switch `outputMode` (`content` | `files_with_matches` | `count`), enable cross-line `multiline: true` (where `count` reports occurrences per file), use `type: "fuzzy"` for case-insensitive path matching, or pass `sortBy: "mtime"` on `glob` queries for newest-first results. - **Resilient & inline-safe:** Uses `rg` when installed with automatic Node.js fallback, auto-recovers common LLM `glob` mistakes (`|` alternation and bare keywords), and enforces the `≤8.8 KB` UTF-8 cap. ### 2. `apply_edits` — Atomic Multi-Hunk & Multi-File Edits + Verify - **Up to 50 files per call:** Validates every hunk and overlap in memory before touching disk (`0` files modified on error), or pass `bestEffort: true` on larger batches so valid files commit atomically per file while failed files return closest-line / drifted-line snippets for targeted retry. - **Faithful file handling:** Preserves CRLF line endings, file permissions, and symlinks; supports `startLine`/`endLine`, `replaceAll`, `create`/`overwrite`, and `dryRun`. - **Inline `verify`:** Optionally runs a build/typecheck/test command right after writing, stripping noisy logs (e.g., Pino/Bunyan info JSON, Maven footers) so root causes stay within budget. ### 3. `quick_outline` — Flat Multi-Language Symbol Outlines - **Up to 40 files per call** *(10–20 recommended per batch)*: Takes a flat `paths: string[]` array to extract exact `[startLine, endLine]` symbol/section maps for **TypeScript / JavaScript** *(incl. Fastify/Express routes & test blocks)*, **HTML / Vue / Svelte**, **CSS / SCSS / Less**, **Python**, **Godot GDScript (`.gd`)**, **Go**, **Rust**, **Java / Kotlin / C# / Swift / C / C++**, **Shell**, **Markdown**, and **JSON / YAML**—making outline-first exploration effortless before parallel built-in `read_file`. ### 4. `read_slices` — Symbol Outlines + Targeted Line Slices - **Outlines + piggybacked slices:** Supports the same 15-format outlines (with breadth-first water-filling per file) plus optional tiny `[startLine, endLine]` slices in one call under the `≤8.8 KB` UTF-8 budget, while steering bulk range reads (`>150` lines) to parallel built-in `read_file`. ### 5. `run_checks` — Concurrent Build, Lint, Test & Diagnostic Runner - **Up to 12 commands per call:** Executes independent non-interactive shell commands in a bounded worker pool (`concurrency: 1..8`) with per-command timeouts (`1..170 s`, sharing a `170 s` call budget under Antigravity's `180 s` MCP limit), ANSI escape stripping, and transparent Windows unwrapping of trivial `powershell -Command "..."` wrappers around allowlisted binaries (`git`, `npm`, `node`, `rg`, `pytest`, `cargo`, etc.) to skip PowerShell cold-start overhead while leaving PowerShell cmdlets/aliases untouched. - **Head-Tail adaptive output modes:** `compact` (default) collapses passing commands to 1-line summaries and uses **Head-Tail folding** on large failures so both initial root-cause errors and final summary/stack tails survive the `≤8.8 KB` inline cap; `full` preserves stdout for diagnostic or audit scripts with Head-Tail folding when capped.
